tasks.gr11-tsarism-1905-revolution-t1: Topic: Tsarism and the 1905 Revolution. Cover autocracy under Tsar Nicholas II, social inequality, opposition groups (peasants, workers, intelligentsia), Bloody Sunday January 1905, the October Manifesto, and the limits of reform. Ask Grade 11 learners to analyse written and visual sources, identify causes and consequences, explain historical concepts, and write structured paragraphs.
tasks.gr11-1917-russian-revolution-t1: Topic: The 1917 Russian Revolution. Cover Russia's role in World War I, the February Revolution and collapse of the Provisional Government, Lenin's April Theses, Bolshevik ideology ('Peace, Land, Bread'), the October Revolution, and Bolshevik seizure of power. Ask Grade 11 learners to analyse sources, sequence events chronologically, compare interpretations, and identify cause and effect.
tasks.gr11-stalins-ussr-t1: Topic: Stalin's USSR — Collectivisation, Industrialisation, and the Purges. Cover Stalin's rise after Lenin, forced collectivisation, the destruction of the kulaks, famine, the Five-Year Plans, rapid industrialisation, the Great Terror, show trials, and the Gulag. Ask Grade 11 learners to evaluate sources, identify bias, compare historical interpretations, and write essay responses.
tasks.gr11-communist-ideology-t1: Topic: Communist Ideology. Cover Marxist concepts (class struggle, bourgeoisie, proletariat, means of production), the Bolshevik vanguard party model, the dictatorship of the proletariat, central planning, state ownership, communist propaganda, and the cult of personality. Ask Grade 11 learners to analyse sources for ideological perspective, compare Marxism with Leninism, and argue from evidence.
